> [!NOTE]
>
\n> **Free plan organizations cannot purchase credits directly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog show
s a message that only an organization owner can upgrade the plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog a

nd opens your organization's Plans settings so you can upgrade.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in t
he desktop app, checkout opens in your default system browser and the dialog closes automatically. Your credit balance updates in

the app once the purchase completes — no redirect back into the app is required.

### Spend budget

An owner or admin can cap
what the whole organization spends on MCPJam-billed\nwork — chat, evals, judges and computer time — for each billing period, from\
reaching the cap always notifies, whether or not you\n list it.\n* Warnings go to the organization's owners and admins in the not

ifications
 bell, and to the owner by email.
* **When the budget is reached**, new chat turns, eval runs and computer starts
are refused for the whole organization. The refusal says the budget is\n reached and that an owner or admin can raise it — buyin

g credits does not
 clear it. Work already in flight finishes, and running computers keep going
 until they hibernate.
* A sc
heduled eval that hits the budget pauses its schedule rather than\n retrying into the same cap every window; it resumes once you

raise the cap or
 the period rolls over.
* Runs that use **your own API keys** are never counted against the budget and
 neve
r blocked by it. Neither is the free daily allowance, which is not\n credits.\n* The window is your organization's own billing pe
riod: the subscription cycle\n for team and enterprise plans, and the calendar month otherwise. Raising or\n lowering the cap mi
d-period does not reset what has already been spent.\n\nAny member can see the budget and how much of it is left; only owners and\

nadmins can change it. Every change is recorded in the organization's audit log
with who made it and what it was before.

The s

ame budget is readable and writable from the API at
`/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget`.

### Managing billing de
tails\n\nOrganization owners on a paid plan see a **Manage billing** button on the billing page. Clicking it opens the Stripe port
al where you can update payment methods, download invoices, add tax IDs, and review billing details. Only organization owners can

access this portal.

### Seat payment failures

When someone you invited to a paid-seat organization signs up and the automati
c seat charge fails or is cancelled, the org billing page shows a **Seat payment didn't go through** notice. As the org owner you

can:

* Click **Retry payment** to reopen the charge and complete payment (including any 3DS challenge).
* Click **Remove invit
e** to remove the invite entirely if you no longer want to add that person.\n\nThe invited member's organization appears greyed ou

t in their sidebar until the seat is paid.
